# Open Air Adventure Park

> > Estes Park's premier outdoor recreation destination offering aerial adventures, ax throwing, and guided Rocky Mountain National Park tours

Open Air Adventure Park provides family-friendly outdoor activities in Estes Park, Colorado, including the region's only aerial adventure park with 32 challenges, ax throwing experiences, and guided kayaking and hiking tours throughout Rocky Mountain National Park. Owned and operated by Tim and Catherine Kreutzer with a dedicated team focused on creating memorable mountain adventures.

## Key Topics

- Estes Park

## Core Activities & Experiences

- [Explore Estes Park: Aerial Adventures and Rocky Mountain Tours](https://www.openairadventurepark.com): Homepage: Aerial adventures, ax throwing & RMNP tours in Estes Park
- [Experience Estes Park's ONLY Aerial Adventure Park](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/aerial-adventure): Estes Park's only aerial adventure park with 32 challenges & zipline
- [Ax Throwing in Estes Park: Unleash Your Inner Lumberjack](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/ax-throwing-in-estes-park): Ax throwing experience with Rocky Mountain views in Estes Park, CO
- [Adventures](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/adventures): Guided kayaking & hiking tours in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Kayak Tours](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/kayak-tours): Guided kayak tours at Lily Lake in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Guided Moonlit Adventure: Hiking in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/rmnp-moonlight-hikes): Guided moonlight hiking tours with stargazing in RMNP near Estes Park
- [Sunrise Adventure in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.openairadventurepark.com/rmnp-sunrise-hikes): Guided sunrise hikes on Emerald Lake Trail in Rocky Mountain National Park
